How much does the first year cost?

The proposed US offer is $499 for the initial equipment rental plus $1,999 for one year of subscription: $2,498 before taxes and shipping. This remains a proposed price pending a confirmed quotation.

What to check before ordering

Your written offer should state currency, delivery, taxes, any duties, product configuration and the payment schedule. The final amount displayed on PayPal must match the agreed offer.
